evidence_quote: This work presents an approach to deliver the qualitative metrics in the form of an energy management maturity model
The scope will not include solutions or approaches to improve or reduce energy consumption at production floor level

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents an energy management maturity model (EM3) - a qualitative, Likert-scale organisational assessment and benchmarking framework - with no EnPI/EnB measurement model characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach identified). Quantitative energy-consumption modelling is explicitly out of scope and deferred to the companion GEMS methodology [23].

paper_type.evidence_quote: we propose an Energy Management Maturity Model (EM3) targeted at an industrial multi-site organisation

stage1.notes: Contribution is a qualitative energy-management maturity model (EM3) validated via a two-year survey case study at Boston Scientific (life-sciences/medical-device manufacturing, 16 sites; discrete manufacturing). EnPI/EnB quantitative modelling explicitly scoped out and deferred to the companion GEMS paper [23].
